30 Jun 2023
Claim reported by the insured's representing attorney following a low-speed collision in a parking lot. Initial notice
received and file opened for bodily injury and property damage review.
5 Jul 2023
Police report obtained. It docuemnts the claimant as an occupant of the vehicle at the time of the impact and records
the other driver's acocunt of the incident.
10 Aug 2023
Recorded statement taken from the other driver, who describes the same sequence of events as the claimant and
confirms the vehicle was stationary and then struck from behind while backing out of a space.
18 Aug 2023
Photographs from the scene and the vehicle's rear bumper and trunk area were received. The visible damage is
mostly in line with the imapct described and appears consistent with the reported speed of contact.
12 Sep 2023
Two indeepndent witnesses contacted this office. Both confirm the collision occurred as described and that the
claimant was seated in the vehicle when it happened.
10 Oct 2023
Verified that the driver is listed as a named driver on the policy and that coverage was in force on the date of loss.
Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
18 Nov 2023
Prior-loss and repair history checked for the vehicle. No earlier damage to this area is known, and no previous claims
were fonud on the vehicle.
24 Nov 2023
Medical records received from the claimant's treating provider. The reported whiplash injury fits the type and force of
this kind of impact, and the diagnosis and imaging notes are in line with that mechanism.
23 Dec 2023
Claimant's attorney provided a prior medical summary. It notes a minor strain to the same region several years ago
that resolved completely with routine care, and it does not appear to bear on the current complaints.
10 Jan 2024
Treatment history reviewed. Care followed a typical course, with frequency of visits tapering as the claimant's
symptoms improved. A later written statement added a few minor details about the moments after impact, but the
core account has remained unchanged across all contacts.
28 Jan 2024
File reviewed and assessed for evaluation. Liability and damage facts are supported by the police report, witnesses,
photographs and the other driver. Injury claim proceeding to evaluation based on the medical cuorse and the
documented mechanism of injury.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
